decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Design and Access Statements,  Fireplace Schedules, Location Plan, Drawing Numbers 921/01, 921/02, 921/03A, 921/04A, 921/D1, 921/D2, 921/D3B, 921D4 received 07/01/14. ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 5 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.

Condition : 6 - Any areas of external brickwork required to be re-instated in accordance with the approved plans shall match the existing brickwork in brick colour and size, mortar colour and pointing and bonding detail.
description: Internal and external alterations to dwelling, including replacement of guttering, rooflight, and balustrades
